You set this in motion. This
was unfolding before your eyes. You
were devastated. You
were blocks from the White House. You
were recalling your reaction. You
quieted. This is for everyone. You
were virtually sorrowful. You
were actual. Am I still there? Your
mind and body were in a different state. You
went on to recount at a staccato pace. You
went on in elliptical passages. You
had pain in watching your creation so distorted. You
are now embarking on a determined third act. You
have for some time been working on a new platform. Yours
was an apparent solid thing with democratic roots but it
has been taken. The futures were fast approaching. Human rights
were being protected in 2009. Résumés
were functioning like the human brain. Political views
are more valuable. Deoxyribo nucleic acid
is enquiring within upon everything. Am I still there? Born
in the early 1960s and growing up in London, what
has been produced
is a large-scale emergent phenomenon which
is anti-human.

Imagining is imagined to be clean and cornerless, like the line between one and the other when we think of a thing working like something else. We say that termites are eusocial in that they work together, and we imagine that the clean and waterless hunting of the Internet might also actually be a form of working together, but I don’t want the analogy of the way termites work to come across and wash away this always there sentiment of the way the world is always waterlessly hunting and replace it with the sense of the time and place of the world where clean water meets and permeates the corner parts of the world, which we say is called a petrichor, and I imagine sadly how a petrichor might have a kind of lifespan, in that it is there at first with a time and place but eventually it runs out.)

not useful when things shiver
or disappear and there is

This is not a record of

It is not a forgetful
payload. And you tidied our
machinery by saying
it is eusocial but I

in a middleware of blue
exceptions. I want to be

actually yes there always

content:
I am the unicorn who fell over.
My yelp called for rain.
The rain was a kind of a malaise.
My feelings as a unicorn are
distributed, and difficult to
measure, but I will tell you
a secret about them. They
(the best of fainting goats) are
continuous with the natural world
because they are a reversal of
the natural world. It is important
that you take better care of me,
because I am economical and
continuous with the natural
world and as real as a row of
olive trees which need watering.
readme: An engraving, hidden in the falling-down part of a museum of natural history, of a myotonic unicorn
title: Unicorns falling

content:
Look at this picture with me and imagine.

The spoiled lazy-bones pushed the unicorns too hard!
Together, they had spent hours trying to find a museum.
They wanted to become smarter.
The unicorns wanted to eat until they were full.
It was a warm day which had cool breezes,
like those under a demonstrative sociocracy.
The unicorns with their spoiled lazy-bones
on top cantered right past the museum.

There was something really lovely about the unicorns—
it was undeniable, even if they had been pushed too hard.

The procession hit the highway, cantering around the cars,
barriers and construction equipment. If you could think
of every possible way—and there are many—
that a thing with four spindles might canter down a highway
in a big woven group, you wouldn't pick this way.
You'd pick something simpler and more likely to return,
where the unicorn might move in an unmechanic
sulk towards the slung balance of volumes, as if to
take into account the empty belly of the animal.

This looked like a parade, but it wasn't.
They were actually trying to get somewhere.

One unicorn fell down because it was so tired.
It yelped, which made the spoiled lazy-bone on top feel sad.
title: Unicorns toiling

content:
The DECIDUOUS- corpus is a body of documents which mirrors recursively the organisational Body responsible for maintaining it; does this restlessly;

it is commonly used to train aesthetic dislocation algorithms, which study the deconvolution of how an outside stopped thing affects inside a person in motion. These algorithms categorically approach a 99% error rate; aren't recommended for use in production;

the corpus can be transformed by componentisation or hygiene against WordNet, a lexical database of words-we-have-agreed-on; please note

this is one of a nearly-infinite "real-world" corpora, and will almost certainly contain missing or incomplete fields, wild pointers, incoherent data. Not enough to not imagine it does not. But no it is almost as certainly "not real-world," is afterwards in proportion, counter, exo: itself an outside stopped thing; the body members are air-gapped from the thick of it;

there's gaps too inside the oily document-responsible bodies. And thatches of loss. Still we ask questions of corpora and their answers ring as bells. You might ask this one: what's changed? What could it have been like now, before it was like this now? What is the convolution of this other possible row of nows with the falloff of our outside afterwards now?

but there is a known issue anyway of overdimensionality in working with deciduity. Asking "what's changed?" causes the corpus to faint. And shed its schema and content sharply. So becomes headless.
